project.name: CEM-QL order queries
project.description: Filter and join owned order/customer records with native CEM-QL expressions and modules, inspect original source ranges, repair query syntax and build JSON tables from declared parameter maps.

entries.name: Inspect retained order data
entries.description: Inspect native generic-data nodes and original JSON source positions without using a serialized AST as query input.

entries.name: Inspect standalone CEM-QL syntax
entries.description: Inspect typed native expression structure with original query URI and UTF-8 token/node ranges.

entries.name: Parse standalone CEM-QL events
entries.description: Review native lossless expression token events, including the Unicode comment and original byte positions.

entries.name: Validate the filter expression
entries.description: Validate input-bound standalone syntax separately from execution or application data rules.

entries.name: Format the standalone expression
entries.description: Apply the native source-preserving tabular query formatter with an exact expected byte fixture.

entries.name: Filter ready order records
entries.description: Select three ready orders and return typed order, units and total fields; the unjoined record remains in this filter result.

entries.name: Validate the local query module
entries.description: Check the explicit module URI, local declarations and root expression; no external library loading is enabled.

entries.name: Format the query module
entries.description: Apply the native source-preserving tabular formatter while retaining module identity and local functions.

entries.name: Join orders to customers
entries.description: Inner-join ready orders totaling at least thirty to their owned customer records; exclude the unmatched customer ID and retain integer result types.

entries.name: Select native order nodes and source ranges
entries.description: Return retained native ready-order nodes with original JSON source boundaries; runtime-local opaque identities are never compared or persisted as portable addresses.

entries.name: Repair the missing CEM-QL closing brace
entries.description: Restore the final block brace after reviewing the two native parse diagnostics at original source positions.

entries.name: Validate the declared parameter model
entries.description: Validate native template parameter declarations and their CEM-QL map/expression slots without inventing unbound host-expression globals.

entries.name: Build ready orders from a parameter map
entries.description: Bind declared status/minimum parameters, construct a native CEM-QL options record and publish an application JSON table through the native generic-data writer.

entries.name: Build draft orders from a parameter map
entries.description: Bind declared status/minimum parameters, construct a native CEM-QL options record and publish an application JSON table through the native generic-data writer.
